stemMd: A 5 N friction force opposes a block moving 7 m on a horizontal surface. What work does friction do on the block?
explanationMd: Work is Fd cos180 degrees, giving −5 times 7=−35 J. The negative sign indicates removal of mechanical energy from the block.

distractorRationale.c: This ignores that force opposes displacement.
distractorRationale.a: This adds force and distance instead of multiplying.
distractorRationale.d: Friction is parallel and opposite, not perpendicular.
